Name: Mephibosheth, Son of Saul
Summary: Mephibosheth, son of Saul by Rizpah — distinct from Mephibosheth son of Jonathan — was handed to the Gibeonites with his brother Armoni in atonement for Saul's bloodguilt and was hanged at the beginning of barley harvest.
KeyStory: Mephibosheth son of Saul, Rizpah's son, was hanged beside his brother for Saul's broken oath.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; Rizpah, Daughter of Aiah; Armoni, Son of Saul
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name, a father, and a fate — and still be different men.
